aarch64 with 4 KiB pages: virtual address bits are not reported unprivileged, so they are inferred from the highest user address the probe mapped (0x7fd31c8000), which lies within 2^39; of the widths Linux offers here (39, 48) the narrowest that fits is 39 bits, and (39 − 12 offset bits) / 9 index bits per level gives 3 levels.
